items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Neal's arrangements -- as far as the band is concerned

ctx.x: I mean, that must have been a very big influence on them. I mean, after all, you're still playing some of that style.
Yeah. We still do some of those things, and I don't know -- I think that has alot to do with it -- Neal's arrangements -- as far as the band is concerned, and as far as the arrangers.
